label: Utah FORGE Phase 3 MT full-density top-contact surface

material.note: Double-sided top-contact surface derived from the full-density MT cell-center tile set. Vertex colors encode top-contact elevation, not resistivity.

source.dataset: Utah FORGE Phase 3 MT resistivity full-density model
source.classification: source-derived full-density inversion model top-contact surface
source.pointRole: top-most source-derived full-density MT cell center retained per XY grid cell

scenePlacement.axisConvention: X east, Y north, Z up

processing.method: Top-contact surface from the full-density MT cell-center tile set. For each 2.5 km XY grid cell, the highest source-derived cell center is retained as the surface contact point.
processing.topologyInference: Adjacent occupied XY cells are triangulated into a renderable surface. No terrain, lidar, seismic, wells, faults, infrastructure, or interpreted geology are used.
notes: This is not public topo, lidar, DEM terrain, or measured ground.
This is not an interpreted geological contact, reservoir boundary, well surface, fault, or seismic horizon.
This is the top contact of the existing source-derived full-density MT cell-center visualization.
Resistivity values are preserved as per-vertex scalar metadata; visible vertex colors encode contact elevation for spatial readability.
